1002.description: A lying straight leg raise with a band held in the hands. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your feet together.
Place the band around the arches of your feet and hold the ends of the band with your hands.
Engaging your abs, lift both legs off the ground until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，双脚并拢。
将带子放在脚弓周围，并用手握住带子的末端。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，直到它们垂直于地板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1130.description: A reverse fly on the straps that works the rear shoulders and upper back to improve posture.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight in front.
Keep your body in a line.
Open your arms wide, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Keep arms slightly bent and level with the shoulders.
Return slowly to the start.
Walk your feet forward to lighten the load.

1194.description: A chest-supported T-bar row lying on the machine pad.
instructions: Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.

1258.description: A wide reverse-grip bench press. It trains the chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a wide reverse grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in and your wrists straight.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest, then push it back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
反握宽握杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部内收，手腕伸直。
当杠铃接触胸部时暂停片刻，然后将其推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1322.description: A rope cable row done chest down on an incline bench. The support keeps your torso still so the upper back does the pulling.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle and attach a cable machine to the low pulley.
Attach a rope handle to the cable machine and sit on the incline bench facing the machine.
Grab the rope handle with an overhand grip and lean forward, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms fully, pulling the rope towards your upper chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 以 45 度角设置上斜凳，并将绳索机连接到低滑轮上。
将绳索手柄连接到缆绳机上，然后坐在面向机器的倾斜长凳上。
正手抓住绳索把手，身体前倾，保持背部挺直。
充分伸展双臂，将绳子拉向上胸部，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢释放张力并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1386.description: A one-leg donkey calf raise where you bend forward and rise onto your toes. It trains the calf with a deep stretch at the bottom.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a stable surface for support, such as a wall or a bar.
Lift one leg off the ground, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将双手放在稳定的表面上以获得支撑，例如墙壁或酒吧。
将一条腿抬离地面，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
使用小腿肌肉，尽可能高地抬高脚跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

1450.description: A static hold at the bottom of a flat flye. It builds chest tension and control in the stretched position.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Open your arms wide with soft elbows until the dumbbells are level with your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and your feet planted.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds without letting the weights drop.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest and set them down carefully.

1514.description: A short-range squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. It lets you handle heavier loads and builds leg strength.
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Bend your knees and hips a short way, about a quarter of the full depth.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

1578.description: A shallow single-leg squat that is easy on the knees. It builds balance and leg strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Extend your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knee and sink down about a quarter of the way.
Keep your knee in line with your toes and your chest up.
Stand back up, then switch legs after your reps.

1642.description: A seated one-arm concentration curl using a cable. It isolates the biceps on one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Hold a cable handle with one hand and place your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Keep your upper arm stationary and curl the cable handle towards your shoulder while exhaling.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上，背部挺直。
用一只手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
呼气时，保持上臂静止并将电缆手柄向肩膀卷曲。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气时慢慢将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1706.description: A forearm plank with your elbows on a stability ball. The wobbly surface makes your abs and shoulders work harder to hold a straight line.
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral and your hips from sagging or rising.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower to the floor.

1770.description: A seated curl with your elbow braced on your inner thigh. Isolates the biceps and cuts out swinging.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1834.description: A gentle stretch that glides the head forward to open the back of the neck and the base of the skull.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.

1898.description: A kneeling stretch with one leg extended to the side to open the inner thigh and groin.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1962.description: A seated stretch for the muscles that lift the toes, using your hand to point the toes downward.
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Gently curl the toes and foot downward until you feel a stretch on the top.
Keep the motion gentle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2090.description: Clasped hands pressed forward with the palms facing out to stretch the forearms.
instructions: Stand or sit tall and interlace your fingers.
Turn your palms outward and straighten your arms in front of you.
Push your hands gently away until you feel the stretch in the forearms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

2154.description: A floor bridge with a band around the thighs to keep the glutes working hard.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Place your feet flat, hip width apart.
Push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly and repeat.

2282.description: A plate-loaded machine movement that strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Set the weight light and adjust the pad to rest on the back of your head.
Sit tall and bring your chin slightly down.
Press your head back against the pad slowly.
Move only through a comfortable range.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

2346.description: A side-by-side form check for back and arm position in bench dips, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2410.description: Standing and bent forward with a weighted harness, you raise your head against the load to build the back of the neck.
instructions: Fit the head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Stand and hinge forward, resting your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest.
Lift your head until your gaze is forward.
Lower slowly and keep the movement small and controlled.

2474.description: A single-leg bridge with the free leg straight, working the glutes and core.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight up.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Push through your planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2666.description: A seated plate-loaded calf raise that focuses on the soleus under the calf.
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad over your thighs.
Release the safety and lower your heels for a stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower slowly to full stretch.

2730.description: Flipping a large tire end over end by driving up from a deep hinge. A full body power move that hits legs, back and chest.
instructions: Stand close to the tire and squat down, getting your fingers under its edge.
Press your chest against the tire with a flat back and hips low.
Explode up with your legs and hips, lifting the tire as you rise.
Shove the tire over with your hands and shoulders, then step in and reset for the next flip.

2858.description: A slow roll up from lying to sitting, training abdominal control and spine flexibility.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and curl your head and chest up.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Reach over your legs.
Roll back down slowly.

2922.description: A curl done with your own body resistance, such as pushing one hand against the other. It is a simple way to train the biceps without equipment.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

2986.description: A weighted pull-up with a neutral hammer grip on a dip cage. It builds the lats and arms with extra load.
instructions: Attach a belt or vest with weight and grip the neutral handles of the cage.
Hang with your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your chest up until your chin passes the handles.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to a full hang and repeat.

3114.description: From all fours, you extend one straight leg back and up. It isolates the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Extend one leg straight back.
Lift it to hip height and squeeze your glute.
Lower without letting your back arch.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3178.description: A reverse hyperextension over a ball at the edge of a bench for glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over the ball and hands on the floor.
Hold the bench or the ball for stability.
Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

3242.description: A gentle lying stretch that draws the knee toward your chest to ease the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

3306.description: A strongman grip challenge based on the legend of Fingal's fingers. It tests hand and forearm strength.
instructions: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.

3370.description: A high energy move combining a jump squat with alternating rope waves. It builds power and conditioning.
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand in a squat position.
Start waving the ropes with alternating arms.
Jump up explosively and land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep going for a set time and rest when needed.

3498.description: A glute bridge with the heels on towels, sliding the feet in and out. It strongly works the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Lower your hips to finish the set.

3562.description: A barbell glute bridge with your upper back on a bench and a bar across the hips. It builds the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Start by sitting on the edge of a bench with your upper back resting against it and your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your glutes and core muscles, then press through your heels to lift your hips off the bench, creating a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在长凳边缘，上背部靠在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，与臀部同宽。
将杠铃放在臀部上，用双手牢牢握住它。
锻炼臀肌和核心肌肉，然后用脚后跟将臀部抬离长凳，形成从膝盖到肩膀的一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3690.description: An overhead press on a stability ball. The unstable seat makes your core work along with the shoulders.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet wide and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

3882.description: A seated machine crunch to the left side that trains the obliques.
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a left side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the left.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

3946.description: Press two dumbbells held together, one arm at a time, while seated upright. It trains the chest with a strong inner squeeze.
instructions: Sit upright with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together in front of your chest.
Keep the two dumbbells touching.
Press one dumbbell forward until the arm is straight.
Bring it back and press with the other arm.
Keep squeezing the weights together.

4010.description: An overhead cable press from a kneeling position. It builds the shoulders and demands core stability.
instructions: Kneel in front of a low cable and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your abs.
Press the handles overhead.
Lower under control.
Keep your hips tall.

4074.description: Pressing a band upward from a low anchor. It trains the upper chest and triceps.
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at chest level.
Step forward into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your core braced.

4138.description: A band curl with a narrow hand position to emphasize the outer biceps.
instructions: Stand on the band and grip it close to your feet with a narrow hold.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands to your shoulders.
Squeeze the top.
Lower slowly.

4202.description: One arm landmine press with a band.
instructions: Hold the landmine end at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press up and forward.
Lock out.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

4330.description: A reverse crunch finished with a leg kick upward, hitting the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Kick your feet up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly and bend your knees again.
Avoid swinging; use your abs to lift.

4394.description: A wall-supported drill to improve overhead reach, one arm at a time, while keeping the back flat against the wall.
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back near the wall.
Raise one arm forward and overhead as far as you can without arching.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.

4458.description: A side plank with both legs straight, held on one forearm. It strengthens the obliques and hips.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your core tight and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds without letting your hips sag.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

4586.description: A front push kick aimed at a bag that builds leg power, balance and hip flexibility.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Lift your rear knee up in front of you.
Extend your leg and push your heel or ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly and keep your guard up.
Pull the leg back to bend it.
Plant your foot and switch sides.

4714.description: A basic bodyweight squat that trains the legs and hips and builds a solid movement pattern.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel with chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

4778.description: Lying on your back, you curl your hips off the floor to bring your knees toward your chest. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

4842.description: A trap bar deadlift with bands adding resistance toward the top. It builds hip and leg power.
instructions: Attach bands to the trap bar and stand inside the bar.
Grip the handles with a flat back and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Lock your hips out at the top against the band.
Lower slowly back to the floor.

4906.description: A decline sit-up with the arms extended overhead. The long lever makes it a tougher core exercise.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, raising your arms with it.
Sit up until your chest is over your thighs.
Lower slowly back down.
Keep your arms reaching forward the whole time.

4970.description: A chin up where you use your legs in a squat position to assist. It helps you build toward full chin ups.
instructions: Grab a bar with an underhand grip.
Bend your knees into a squat position.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
Lower slowly.
Keep your shoulders down.

5034.description: One-arm row with the end of a landmine barbell. It builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Stand over the end of a landmine bar and hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Grab the bar end or attachment with one hand.
Pull the bar up toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

5098.description: Perform chest flys with one dumbbell at a time. The alternating pattern challenges stability while working the chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower one arm out to the side in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest to bring it back up.
Alternate with the other arm.

5162.description: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the neck. It helps ease tension from desk time.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the back of your head.
Gently guide your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release slowly and repeat.

5226.description: A wide-grip shrug with the barbell held behind your body. It hits the traps from a slightly different angle.
instructions: Hold a barbell behind your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower slowly without leaning forward.

5482.description: Low-impact hopping on one leg to build ankle stiffness, balance and leg power.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms ready.
Hop up and forward or in place using your ankle and knee.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Stay balanced and keep your hips level.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

5738.description: A push-up style press on suspension straps. The unstable handles make your chest, arms and core work together.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your hands by your chest and elbows bent.
Press yourself away until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips in line.
Lower back slowly with control.

5866.description: A diamond push-up with your feet raised. It shifts the load toward the triceps and upper chest.
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up to straight arms.

6058.description: A standing press with a bottle squeezed between your palms. It keeps constant tension on the chest.
instructions: Stand tall and press your palms together around a bottle at your chest.
Squeeze inward the whole time.
Push the bottle straight out in front of you.
Pause with your arms extended.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.

6442.description: From a hovering bear plank position, you kick one leg back to fire up your glutes while your core stays steady.
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Bring the knee back in without touching down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

6570.description: A glute bridge held high while stepping the feet out and back. It adds a dynamic challenge for glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep the hips high and walk your feet out a few small steps.
Then walk them back in toward your body.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Lower with control when finished.

6698.description: A standing curl holding a single plate. The plate grip also challenges your hands and forearms.
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at its sides with both hands, arms down.
Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the plate slowly to full arm extension.

6762.description: A standing diagonal bend held for a stretch through the back and side of the body.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips.
Reach one arm overhead and toward the opposite foot.
Bend diagonally, keeping your hips facing forward.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to standing and switch sides.

6890.description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. The position removes leg drive and demands a strong core.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back tall.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders under control.
Avoid leaning back during the press.

7210.description: A plank with jumping feet and a band around the legs, working your core while the hips resist.
instructions: Place the band above your knees and get into a high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Repeat at a steady pace.

7274.description: Plank with feet in suspension straps, piking the hips up to work the abs and shoulders.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.

7850.description: Lie on your back with your hips raised, pedalling the legs in a backward motion. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.

8362.description: A one-arm side raise using band tension to train the middle part of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand at your side.
Keep a slight bend in the elbow and your torso still.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

8618.description: A seated pressing motion done with bodyweight tension to work the chest and triceps.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.

8874.description: A quick lateral stepping drill with a band around the legs to speed up the feet and fire the glutes.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat.
Take quick small steps to the side.
Keep tension on the band and your chest up.
Move in both directions.

9002.description: A plank where you extend an opposite arm and leg to challenge balance. It builds trunk stability.
instructions: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
Hold for a few seconds.
Return and switch sides.

9066.description: Hopping on one leg forward, back and side to side trains balance, ankle stability and power.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then hop to each side.
Hold each landing for a moment.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your foot.
Repeat the pattern, then switch legs.

9322.description: A dragon flag lowering with one leg extended and one tucked. It's a step between the half and full versions.
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line with one leg tucked.
Extend the other leg straight.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips level.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and switch legs.

9514.description: A vertical jump with hands on your hips so the legs do all the work. It develops explosive leg power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Reach for maximum height without using your arms.
Land softly on bent knees and reset.

10410.description: A squat holding a steel mace across the shoulders or upper back. It builds leg strength and a braced trunk.
instructions: Rest the mace on your shoulders and hold it with both hands.
Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

10538.description: A variation of the seated knee extension. It builds thigh strength with a small, controlled range.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10730.description: A hip hinge with a sandbag held in front of your thighs. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your back flat.

10858.description: A dumbbell raise that lifts the arms out and up in an L to U path. It builds shoulder strength and upper back control.
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms upward so the dumbbells point to the ceiling.
Pause, then lower back down the same path with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid shrugging.

10922.description: A standing stretch for the back of the lower leg and the Achilles area.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and the knee slightly bent.
Lean forward until you feel the stretch low in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

11050.description: Seated knee abduction against band resistance with feet lifted. It trains the outer hips.
instructions: Sit tall with a band around your thighs and feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees against the band.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

0042.description: The barbell front squat with the bar resting on the front of the shoulders. Heavy on the quads and core.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell in front of your shoulders, resting it on your collarbone and shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在肩膀前面，将其放在锁骨和肩膀上。
当你将身体降低到蹲姿时，收紧核心并保持挺胸，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0106.description: A standing curl with a narrow grip. Builds the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, hands close together.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl the weights while contracting your biceps. Continue to raise the bar until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale as you slowly begin to bring the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，双手并拢。
在整个运动过程中，保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
弯举哑铃时呼气，同时收缩二头肌。继续抬高杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢开始将杠铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0170.description: An incline cable fly performed on a stability ball. Trains the chest and core stability.
instructions: Set up a stability ball at an incline angle.
Attach the cable handles to the high pulleys of a cable machine.
Sit on the stability ball facing away from the machine, with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip, palms facing forward.
Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
With a controlled motion, bring your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Continue the motion until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 以倾斜角度设置稳定球。
将电缆手柄连接到电缆机的高滑轮上。
背对机器坐在稳定球上，双脚牢牢踩在地面上。
正手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝前。
稍微向前倾，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
控制动作，将手臂向两侧伸出，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
继续这个动作，直到手臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0234.description: A standing cable row with a v-bar. You pull toward your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades together.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar attachment with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the v-bar towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住 V 形杆附件，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将 V 形杆拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0298.description: A hammer curl that crosses the body toward the opposite shoulder. It works the biceps and the brachialis.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps, bringing the dumbbells across your body towards your opposite shoulder.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌，将哑铃穿过身体拉向对侧的肩膀。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0362.description: With one arm supported on a bench, you extend the other arm to work the back of the upper arm. A strict triceps isolation move.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your other hand on the bench for support.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, keeping your upper arm close to your head and your elbow pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Extend your arm back up to the starting position, fully straightening your elbow.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
一手握住哑铃，另一只手放在长凳上以获得支撑。
将哑铃举过头顶，保持上臂靠近头部，肘部向前。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到头后，保持上臂静止。
将手臂向后伸展至起始位置，完全伸直肘部。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0426.description: Standing, you press dumbbells from your shoulders to overhead. It builds the shoulders, triceps and trunk stability.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

0490.description: An incline push-up with a narrow hand position. It targets the triceps and chest.
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, with your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the elevated surface by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将双手放在较高的表面上，例如长凳或台阶上，双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将胸部降低到升高的表面。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0554.description: With a kettlebell held overhead, you push your hips out and reach down toward your foot. Builds shoulder stability, flexibility and core strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand overhead.
Rotate your left foot outwards about 45 degrees and keep your right foot pointing forward.
Bend your torso to the left side, keeping your right arm extended overhead and your eyes on the kettlebell.
Lower your torso as far as you can while keeping your right arm straight and your left arm extended to the side.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position by pushing through your right foot and engaging your obliques.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住壶铃举过头顶。
将左脚向外旋转约 45 度，并保持右脚指向前方。
将你的躯干向左侧弯曲，保持右臂伸过头顶，眼睛盯着壶铃。
尽可能降低躯干，同时保持右臂伸直，左臂向一侧伸展。
暂停片刻，然后通过推动右脚并接合斜肌返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0746.description: On the smith machine, you lift your shoulders straight up with the bar. Builds the upper traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and allow the barbell to hang in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
保持手臂伸直，让杠铃挂在大腿前面。
将肩膀向耳朵方向伸直，挤压斜方肌顶部。
保持一会儿，然后将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0810.description: A wall sit with a toe touch added. The reach makes your trunk work while your legs hold the squat.
instructions: Lean against a wall and slide down into a wall sit.
Hold the squat position with your feet flat.
Reach forward and down with your hands toward your toes.
Return to an upright position against the wall.
Repeat for the set, keeping the sit steady.
Slide back up when finished and keep your knees at about 90 degrees.

0874.description: A standing cable crunch with a rope held behind the head, curling the torso forward. It strengthens the abs.
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable machine at chest height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the rope with both hands and bring it behind your head, keeping your elbows bent.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch your torso forward, bringing your elbows towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the crunch, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将一根绳子连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手握住绳子并将其放在脑后，保持肘部弯曲。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挤压躯干，使肘部靠近膝盖。
在卷腹的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0938.description: Climb on a lever stepper machine at a steady pace. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and glutes.
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly for balance.
Push one pedal down while the other rises, keeping a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your knees pointing forward.
Continue at a comfortable pace for several minutes, adjusting resistance as needed.
Slow down gradually before stepping off.
